## Hydrographic & Bathymetric Submissions

We ingest raw soundings, sonar recordings, bathymetric point clouds (CSV/XYZ), and passage tracklogs (GPX/NMEA 0183/2000). Contributions can be attributed publicly or kept strictly anonymous per your instructions.

[data@freeopenocean.com](mailto:data@freeopenocean.com)

## General Inquiries & Engineering

For project partnerships, API integrations, server infrastructure sponsorship, or technical feedback, contact our engineering group directly.

[contact@freeopenocean.com](mailto:contact@freeopenocean.com)

## Base of Operations

Independent Maritime Software Initiative

Atlantic Coast, United States

Focus: Open Bathymetry, Real-Time Marine Weather, and Direct Vessel Telemetry.
